answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can split each identity through a prism of independent checks: proof of completed work, a refundable stake, and vouches from peers in unrelated clusters. A newcomer must pass all three facets before it can earn, and its history stays public, so a fake identity cannot wander in, copy one credential, and blend into the crowd. Forging every facet at once costs far more than any single payout, while one honest record, set like onyx in the ledger, compounds over time.
